content: Fixed 2026-05-09 in v1.4.0. get_open_threads now splits the filename stem on comma and matches any element against the requested domain. Threads tagged with multiple comma-separated domains are now correctly surfaced by single-domain queries. The broken case (openai-bridge,cross-system-inquiry,... invisible to domain=openai-bridge) now works.
resolved_from: get_open_threads domain filter is more brittle than its name suggests — does it
